meta.name: Facundo Mancini
meta.description: Persona profile + AI slop detection patterns for belioras-frontend

persona.name: facundo

style.comments: rare, when present often have typos
style.consoleLog: liberal use throughout, even for trivial things
style.errorHandling: simple try/catch or if/else, no custom error classes
style.abstraction: minimal, inline logic preferred over helper functions
style.loopStyle: for...of or for i, rarely forEach
style.exports: named exports or default, no barrel files

antiPatterns: verbose variable names like 'fetchedUserData' instead of 'user'
excessive JSDoc or inline comments explaining obvious things
forEach when a for...of would be simpler
trying to add TypeScript types in JSX files
index parameters in callbacks unless truly needed
over-abstraction with utility functions for one-off logic
wrapper components that just pass props through
abstract factory patterns for simple state

detectionPatterns.description: Overly verbose variable names that sound like AI generated them
detectionPatterns.human替代: use short names: data, res, val, item, el, etc.

detectionPatterns.description: Comments that explain what the code obviously does
detectionPatterns.human替代: no comments unless truly complex; if commented, mention WHY not WHAT

detectionPatterns.description: Using .forEach() inside JSX or component logic instead of for...of or map
detectionPatterns.human替代: for...of for side effects, .map() for rendering lists

detectionPatterns.description: Using index as callback parameter when it's not needed
detectionPatterns.human替代: (item) => ... — only use index if you actually need it

detectionPatterns.description: Tiny helper functions that should just be inline
detectionPatterns.human替代: inline the logic directly, no need for a wrapper

detectionPatterns.description: API calls or state changes without console.log for debugging
detectionPatterns.note: flag if no console.log exists in same file

detectionPatterns.description: useMemo/useCallback in components that don't need optimization
detectionPatterns.human替代: skip memoization unless there's a measured perf issue

detectionPatterns.description: Component that just renders children with no logic
detectionPatterns.human替代: remove the wrapper, use the child directly

detectionPatterns.description: index.js barrel files that just re-export
